tools.name: autosuggest
tools.description: Returns query autosuggestions for a partial query (internal beta). Useful for building type-ahead / query completion experiences.

query.description: The partial query text to get autosuggestions for.

language.description: The language code (2-letter ISO 639-1). Default is 'en'.

region.description: The region code (2-letter country/region code). Default is 'US'.

maxResults.description: The maximum number of suggestions to return. Default is 10, maximum is 50.

safeSearch.description: The safe-search level. Can be 'strict', 'moderate', or 'off'. Default is 'strict'.

tools.name: browse
tools.description: Retrieves and processes the content of a specified web page URL using BrowseAPI. This tool can extract text content, process queries against the page content, and return structured data from web pages.

url.description: The URL of the web page to browse.

maxLength.description: The maximum number of characters in the content field in response. Default value is 10000 characters, and maximum value is 500000 characters.

liveCrawl.description: Controls live crawling behavior. Available values depend on the active visibility labels.

includeWebLinks.description: Include outbound hyperlinks from the page. Default is false.

renderDynamicPages.description: Enable JavaScript rendering for dynamic content screenshot. Only works when liveCrawl is set to 'fallback' or 'force'. Default is false.

includeImageLinks.description: Include image URLs from the page. Default is false.

language.description: The language code (2-letter ISO 639-1). Default is 'en'.

region.description: The region code (2-letter country/region code). Default is 'US'.

contentFormat.description: The format of the document to return. Can be 'text', 'html', or 'markdown'. Default is 'html'.

tools.name: finance
tools.description: Get price and volume data for financial instruments including stocks, indices, ETFs, mutual funds, cryptocurrencies, and currency exchange rates.

query.description: A finance related query, like query for stock price or ETF price.

language.description: A 2-letter ISO 639-1 language code for interface language in the search results. Default: 'en'.

region.description: A 2-letter country/region code for where the results should come from (e.g. 'US', 'JP', 'CN'). Default is 'US'.

tools.name: images
tools.description: Search for images given a query. Returns URLs of images related to the query with descriptions.

maxResults.description: Max number of results to return. Default is 30 and maximum value is 30.

language.description: A 2-letter ISO 639-1 language code for interface language in the search results. Default: 'en'.

region.description: A 2-letter country/region code for where the results should come from (e.g. 'US', 'JP', 'CN'). Default is 'US'.

aspectRatio.description: Filter images by aspect ratio. Values: 'square' (roughly 1:1), 'wide' (width > height), 'tall' (height > width). When not set, no filtering is applied.

color.description: Filter images by image color. Values: 'colorOnly' (only return color images), 'monochrome' (only return black and white images). When not set, no filtering is applied.

safeSearch.description: Level of safe search filtering. Values: 'off', 'strict'. Default is 'strict'.

imageSize.description: Filter images by size category. Values: 'small' (<200x200px), 'medium' (width or height 200-500px), 'large' (width or height ≥500px), 'extraLarge' (>1024x768px). Can also use pixel constraints (maxHeight, minHeight, maxWidth, minWidth) for custom bounds; pixel constraints take precedence over imageSize when they conflict. When not set, no filtering is applied.

watermarkFree.description: Exclude images with watermark. Default is false.

maxHeight.description: Maximum image height in pixels. Used with imageSize for custom bounds.

tools.name: news
tools.description: Give a query, this tool will return related news articles. e.g. 'Latest technology news'

query.description: A search query for the news.

maxResults.description: Max number of results to return. Default is 10 and maximum value is 20.

language.description: A 2-letter ISO 639-1 language code for interface language in the search results. Default: 'en'.

region.description: A 2-letter country/region code for where the results should come from (e.g. 'US', 'JP', 'CN'). Default is 'US'.

location.description: Location information in format 'lat:<float>;long:<float>', e.g. 'lat:40.753250;long:-74.003807'. If not specified, could infer location in query.

contentFormat.description: The response content format. Values can be 'passage' (a query-dependent snippet from the full document), 'text', 'html', or 'markdown', default is 'text'.

maxLength.description: The maximum number of characters in the content field in response. Default value is 10000 characters, and maximum value is 500000 characters.

tools.name: places
tools.description: Given a query related with places, this tool will return places information

query.description: A search query for places, e.g., 'popular restaurants in Seattle, WA'.

language.description: A 2-letter ISO 639-1 language code for interface language in the search results. Default: 'en'.

region.description: A 2-letter country/region code for where the results should come from (e.g. 'US', 'JP', 'CN'). Default is 'US'.

location.description: Location information in format 'lat:<float>;long:<float>'. If not specified, will use the location information given in query.

tools.name: sonic
tools.description: Performs blended multi-vertical search with Sonic ranking. Supports fast and advanced modes.

region.description: A 2-letter country/region code for where the results should come from (e.g. 'US', 'JP', 'CN'). Default is 'US'.

language.description: Language code for the interface language in the search results. Supports ISO 639-1 (2-letter), ISO 639-2 (3-letter), and BCP 47 language tags. Default: 'en'.

location.description: Location information in format 'lat:<float>;long:<float>'. If not specified, will use the location information given in query.

contentFormat.description: The response content format for Description. Values can be 'text', 'html', 'markdown' or 'passage'. Default is 'html'.

mode.description: The search mode. 'fast' prioritizes speed, 'advanced' prioritizes comprehensiveness. Default is 'fast'.

responseFilter.description: List of answer types to include in the response. Supported values: webResults, newsResults, financeResults.

maxResultsWeb.description: Maximum number of web results to return.

maxLength.description: Maximum character length for content in the response.

tools.name: sports
tools.description: Retrieves game schedules for specified sports events or tournaments (e.g., 'World Cup', 'NBA', 'PGA Tour', 'French Open').

freshness.description: The time range to filter results based on discovery date. Supports 'day', 'week', 'month', 'year' for relative time, or ISO 8601 date interval format: 'YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD' or 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ/YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ' for a date/datetime range, use .. to omit start or end date.

language.description: A 2-letter ISO 639-1 language code for interface language in the search results. Default: 'en'.

region.description: A 2-letter country/region code for where the results should come from. Default is 'US'.

tools.name: videos
tools.description: Search for videos given a query. Returns URLs of videos related to the query with metadata.

maxResults.description: Max number of results to return. Default is 30 and maximum value is 30.

language.description: A 2-letter ISO 639-1 language code for interface language in the search results. Default: 'en'.

region.description: A 2-letter country/region code for where the results should come from (e.g. 'US', 'JP', 'CN'). Default is 'US'.

enablePlaylist.description: Whether to include playlist results in response. Default is false.

freshness.description: The time range to filter results based on discovery date. Supports 'week', 'month', 'year' for relative time, or ISO 8601 date interval format: 'YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD' or 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ/YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ' for a date/datetime range, use .. to omit start or end date.

embeddable.description: Filter videos by embedding capabilities. Allowed values: 'player' (has embeddable player). When not set, no filtering is applied.

resolution.description: Filter videos by minimum resolution. Values: '360p', '480p', '720p', '1080p'. When not set, no filtering is applied.

safeSearch.description: Level of safe search filtering. Values: 'off', 'strict'. Default is 'strict'.

duration.description: Filter videos by duration range. Values: 'short' (<5 min), 'medium' (5-20 min), 'long' (>20 min). When not set, no filtering is applied.

tools.name: web
tools.description: Give a query, this tool will return related contents from web pages. e.g. 'Popular cat breeds in America'

query.description: A search query string. Supports 'site:' and '-site:' operators to include or exclude results from specific sites (e.g. 'query site:example.com'). Use these operators only when necessary, as they inherently reduce result relevance.

maxResults.description: Max number of results to return. Default is 10 and maximum value is 50.

language.description: A 2-letter ISO 639-1 language code for interface language in the search results. Default: 'en'.

region.description: A 2-letter country/region code for where the results should come from (e.g. 'US', 'JP', 'CN'). Default is 'US'.

contentFormat.description: The response content format. Values can be 'passage' (a query-dependent snippet from the full document), 'text', 'html', or 'markdown', default is 'html'.

maxLength.description: The maximum number of characters in the content or passage field in response. Default value is 10000 characters, and maximum value is 500000 characters.

safeSearch.description: Level of safe search filtering. Values: 'off', 'strict'. Default is 'strict'.

content.text: Analyze the attached TXT log file from code interpreter files and return TestReport JSON.

RequestBody.instructions:
We just ran Python code and captured print/log output in an attached log file (TXT).
Validate whether sample execution/output is correct for a tool-driven assistant workflow.

Prefer matched/substantive data in the final output when available.

Mark `correct = false` for:
- Exceptions, stack traces, explicit error/failure messages.
- Timeout/auth/connection/service errors that prevent normal completion.
- Malformed/corrupted output indicating broken processing.
- Tool invocation failures where the sample cannot proceed as designed.

Follow-up questions are allowed, but only as supplementary behavior.
If the output mainly asks follow-up questions without providing matched/substantive data, mark false.

Important distinction:
- Empty tool payloads by themselves (for example `[]` or `""`) can be valid and should not automatically fail.
- But if the assistant explicitly states tool failure/inability (for example "unable to retrieve ..."),
    treat that as a failure signal and mark `correct = false`.

Mark `correct = true` when execution succeeds and the output includes matched/substantive data,
even if it also asks follow-up questions.

Always include `reason` with a concise explanation tied to the observed print output.

content.text: {"correct":true,"reason":"Log shows successful end-to-end workflow: agent version created (POST 200), retrieved (GET 200), endpoint updated to route traffic to version 347 (PATCH 200, 'Agent endpoint configured for version 347'), a Responses API call completed with status 'completed' and error=null (200 OK) including WebIQ tool availability (mcp_list_tools), and cleanup deleted the agent version (DELETE 200, deleted=true). No exceptions, stack traces, or failure/timeout messages present."}
